grouping.primary_identity: LAS UWI, checked against unique member/well identity
grouping.parent_well_rule: match full UWI with ^([0-9]+/[0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[ ]+[A-Z0-9 -]+)?$ and use capture1; sidetracks/suffix variants stay together
grouping.unknown_identity: fail and seek main review; no guessed fallback or row-based split
grouping.source_domains: FORCE wells, sensor acquisition runs and sim_em_v2 complete scenarios have independent manifests; derivatives inherit the complete parent split

assignment.algorithm: sort parent-well groups by SHA256(UTF8(salt + newline + parent_well_id)), tie-break by parent_well_id; first floor(0.70*N) train, next floor(0.15*N) validation, remainder test
assignment.outcome_independence: Only verified well identities and fixed salt determine assignment; no class count, model output, missingness or metric influences allocation
assignment.resplit_policy: No reroll to improve scores or class coverage; report absent classes and all failed/missing observations
assignment.official_challenge_split: This project split is separately identified; no claim of reproducing the original FORCE leaderboard split

preprocessing.fit_domain: training wells only, after immutable split manifest exists
preprocessing.RDEP: log10 for positive observed values only; nonpositive resistivity is invalid/masked and counted; fixed transform not fitted on validation/test
preprocessing.missing_sensors: train-derived centering for imputation with explicit zero mask; no whole-dataset interpolation or backwards filling from future points
preprocessing.scaling: train-only finite statistics; record fitting wells and parameters/hash; all-missing training channel is a blocker rather than a guessed scale
preprocessing.windows: complete-well causal trailing windows of actual selected points; left padding masked; never cross a well, split or complete replay run
preprocessing.evaluation: all frozen test wells remain in denominator; no dropping bad wells after observing performance

acceptance: C01/C02 not_run; assignments and preprocessing must be implemented and independently tested
